faq.q: Is February a good month for a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, February 2031 is a good month for a yacht charter if you prefer mild weather and fewer crowds. Expect daytime highs of 14°C, calm seas, and around 70% sunny days. It is cooler than summer but still pleasant for cruising, with low rain and light winds.

faq.q: What is the average temperature in Marbella in February 2031?
faq.a: Average high temperatures in February 2031 are around 14°C, with lows of 8°C. Sea temperatures hover near 15°C. Pack a jacket and layers for the breeze on deck, but you will still enjoy comfortable conditions for a few hours out on the water.

faq.q: How much rain does Marbella get in February?
faq.a: February typically sees about 40mm of rainfall spread over 5-6 days. That means most days are dry, with only occasional showers. If rain is forecast, morning departures often offer clearer skies before afternoon clouds build.

faq.q: What is the sea like in February off Marbella?
faq.a: The Mediterranean Sea off Marbella in February is generally calm, with wave heights around 0.5-1 metre. Wind speeds average 10-15 knots from the west. These conditions are suitable for most boats in our fleet, including smaller speedboats and larger yachts.

faq.q: Can I swim or use water toys in February?
faq.a: Swimming is possible but the sea is chilly at 15°C. Most guests prefer to enjoy the cruise and scenery rather than swim. Jet skis are available on the Mangusta 80 charter (€4,719/4h), but be prepared for cold water.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a February charter?
faq.a: Enclosed flybridge or cabin boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offer shelter from the breeze. For a budget option, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749/2h includes a cabin and heating if needed.

faq.q: What should I wear for a February yacht charter?
faq.a: Wear layers: a thermal base, a fleece or jumper, and a windproof jacket. Trousers and closed-toe shoes are recommended. Bring a hat and sunglasses for sun protection, and a light scarf for cooler moments. The sun is still strong at midday.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht charter in February 2031?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing and availability on all boats except Tier A and B. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749/2h and can be booked directly. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

data.body_html:
February 2031 in Marbella offers a quieter, more affordable window for a marbella yacht charter february 2031. With average highs of 14°C, calm seas, and around 70% sunny days, it is a solid month for cruising the Costa del Sol without summer crowds. Our all-inclusive fleet departs Puerto Banús, with prices starting at €749 for two hours. Read on for the weather breakdown and what to expect.

February 2031 Weather Averages for Marbella

Daytime temperatures in February 2031 range from 8°C (night) to 14°C (afternoon). Sea temperature sits at 15°C, so swimming is brisk but possible. Wind averages 10-15 knots from the west, creating gentle chop rather than rough seas. Rainfall totals around 40mm over 5-6 days, meaning most days are dry. Sunrise is at 07:50, sunset at 18:45, giving you nearly 11 hours of daylight.

Why Charter in February? Fewer Crowds, Lower Prices

February is low season along the Golden Mile and Puerto Banús. You will share the marina with locals and a handful of visitors, not the July crush. Our boat rental Marbella fleet is available at standard rates, with Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) from €749/2h. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) requires a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What to Wear on a February Yacht Charter

Layering is key. Start with a thermal base, add a fleece or jumper, and top with a windproof jacket. Trousers and closed-toe shoes protect against spray. Sunglasses and sunscreen are essential — the UV index still reaches 4-5 at midday. A light scarf or buff helps against cool gusts during cruising.

Best Boats for February Conditions

Enclosed flybridge or cabin yachts offer comfort in cooler weather. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) provides shelter and panoramic views. The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) and Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) include heated interiors. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) has a cabin and is priced at €749/2h. Speedboats like the Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are best for short, sunny afternoon runs.

Typical February Itineraries from Puerto Banús

Head east to Cabopino or Cala del Faro for a 2-3 hour cruise past the dunes. Westbound, Estepona and Sotogrande offer longer day trips (6-8 hours) with stops for lunch. Cala Cortés is a sheltered anchorage for a quiet afternoon. All itineraries include the skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks — no hidden costs.
